turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
CANCEL, HOW LONG UNTIL I'M REFUNDED?
For most orders, we can’t cancel once they’re placed, so there isn’t a cancellation refund timeline. If you return an eligible item after it arrives, we issue the refund to your original payment method within 10 BUSINESS DAYS AFTER WE RECEIVE AND INSPECT IT; your bank or card company may take additional time to post it.
Orders shipped into the EU have a separate 14-day cancellation or return right. Is your order shipping to the EU?
